description: Calculate planetary strength and relationships. Chandra Bala = Moon strength (8 types for muhurta timing). Tara Bala = nakshatra compatibility (9 Tara groups). Upagraha = sub-planet positions (Dhuma, Vyatipata, Parivesha, Chapa, Upaketu, Gulika, Mandi). Planet Relationship = Naisargika Maitri friendship table per BPHS. Shadbala = the 6-fold strength system (Sthana, Dig, Kala, Cheshta, Naisargika, Drik bala), normalized 0-100. Cost: $0.020/call.

ayanamsa.description: Sidereal zodiac correction. Default: lahiri. Only for Vedic calculations.

datetime.description: Birth date and time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. "1990-06-15T14:30:00". Required for all chart calculations.

latitude.description: Birth location latitude (-90 to 90). Polar latitudes >66.5 are rejected (house calculations unreliable).

timezone.description: Timezone as UTC offset "+05:30" or IANA "Asia/Kolkata". UTC offsets preferred.

type.description: chandra-bala=Moon strength. tara-bala=nakshatra compatibility. upagraha=sub-planets. planet-relationship=friendship table. shadbala=6-fold strength (most comprehensive).

name: vedika_strength
